notes:
New in 0.1.4.8 - faster water:
- About 1.4-1.6x faster water calculation on one core (calm sea about 1.6x, during waves about 1.5x), winning back most of what the smaller pixels cost.
- The game now needs a CPU with AVX2 (Intel since 2013, AMD since 2015).
- Please run the F5 benchmark once: it tells how the speed-up looks on your PC with all cores.
